finding_summary: No P0, P1, P2, or P3 findings.

identity.contract_gate_note: The reduced repository framework has no scripts/design_contracts.py. The applicable repository contract gate is scripts/check_common_contracts.py plus exact frozen infrastructure index, contract, dependency, and source-manifest SHA checks.

package_inventory.audit: Exact scalar constants, masks, list counts/IDs, types, widths, and depths were checked statically and dynamically by the independent probe.

structure_and_safety_audit.mm2s_decode: Payload, address, and strobe are direct-broadcast to banks 0, 1, and 2; only the selected legal bank receives ena. Bank 3 has a separate 1024-bit SA_OUT write interface.
structure_and_safety_audit.read_data: Response data is a direct exact-width connection from the selected fixed bank port. It may change outside response-valid and is not a transaction unless the corresponding response-valid is asserted.
structure_and_safety_audit.authorization: MM2S is checked active and role-capable before ownership-array indexing; every request additionally requires bank_busy and exact owner equality.
structure_and_safety_audit.denied_access: Inactive/BANK_NONE, unsupported role, free bank, wrong owner, and bank3 read collision all hold ready low and suppress every affected physical ena/enb.
structure_and_safety_audit.collision: Concurrent S2MM and SA_OUT reads of bank 3 suppress bank3_enb and both response pipelines; different-bank operations remain concurrent. Bank3 read and write may coexist on separate physical ports.
structure_and_safety_audit.fault: The first denied request is sticky until synchronous active-low reset, with deterministic MM2S, S2MM, ACT, WGT, OUT-read, OUT-write priority.
structure_and_safety_audit.latency_and_reset: Each accepted read shifts one valid token through exactly three stages at II=1. Reset flushes all response-valid pipelines and sticky fault state.
structure_and_safety_audit.consumer_qualification: The router contains no consumer. The independent probe models acceptance only on response-valid and proves direct data changes alone create no acceptance. Every downstream integration must preserve the frozen valid-only qualification rule.

vivado_ooc.source_closure: exactly bank_config_pkg.sv and bank_sparse_router.sv; no testbench, IP, generated memory, or blackbox
vivado_ooc.timing_exceptions: Hold-only false paths cover unplaced external inputs and outputs. Internal register-to-register hold remains timed; the worst hold path is act_pipe_r_reg[0]/Q to act_pipe_r_reg[1]/D.
vivado_ooc.resource_interpretation: The reduction is credible because wide payloads became direct wires and physical enables/response-valid retain transaction qualification; the synthesized netlist still contains all 23 response/fault registers and 92 control/address LUTs.
vivado_ooc.warnings: The empty blackbox query and OOC connectivity-coverage warnings are nonfunctional. This is an external-BUFG, unplaced OOC timing context and not board timing.

scope_and_limitations.validated: Bounded compile-time sparse heterogeneous bank routing/control at the frozen inventory and default fixed widths, including request authorization, physical-enable suppression, response-valid latency, payload wiring, reset, lint, and 200 MHz post-synthesis OOC timing.
residual_risks: Actual BRAM/URAM integration must honor ena/enb and the exact three-cycle memory data contract.
Every downstream consumer must sample direct response data only when its response-valid is asserted; no downstream consumer is instantiated in this module.
The direct 1024-bit bank3 wiring and external interfaces must be remeasured after hierarchy integration, placement, and routing.
OOC external-port hold paths are intentionally excluded because the ports are unplaced; only internal register-to-register hold is meaningful here.
not_validated: physical BRAM or URAM instances and read-during-write behavior
